::: {.obsidian-talking-points}
:::

State the purpose of the briefing in one sentence.

# Key messages

- Write the first key message.
- Write the second key message.
- Write the third key message.

# Supporting points

Give one or two sentences of support for each key message.

# Likely questions

Anticipate the questions the audience will ask. Draft a short answer
for each.
